questions.explanation_english: Article 46 of the Constitution of India directs the State to promote with special care the educational and economic interests of the weaker sections of the people, and, in particular, of the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes, and to protect them from social injustice and all forms of exploitation. It forms the constitutional basis for reservations and special schemes for SCs and STs. The Supreme Court has repeatedly cited Article 46 to uphold protective discrimination measures. questions.explanation_english: The Bhabar is a narrow, continuous physical belt spanning eight to sixteen kilometers in width running along the foothills of the Shiwalik Range.
